title: Phase 12 Post-Launch Retrospective — LCH-04 retro template schema
description: Repository-only LCH-04 post-launch retrospective contract (PLAN.md section 8 LCH-04: the owner team completes a structured retrospective after a successful launch and files action items with owners). This schema governs a fillable TEMPLATE only: retroStatus is restricted to PENDING | TEMPLATE | NOT_STARTED, published/completed/filed/closed are const false, no retro session exists (sessionDate/facilitator null), no participant or finding is recorded, and action items are structurally absent (actionItemsFiled const false, count const 0, items maxItems 0). PUBLISHED, COMPLETED, FILED, and CLOSED retro statuses, a true actionItemsFiled, a non-zero action-item count, and any real action item are forbidden positive claims and are never valid values here: publishing a retro and filing action items requires a completed launch and LCH-03 hypercare closure, which are owner/external operations outside this repository. No EV-* reference, UUID, ticket ID, or URL can authorize a claim. It does not duplicate or override config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production, dataStage synthetic-only, scope browser-only).

retroStatus.description: Retro session state. PUBLISHED, COMPLETED, FILED, and CLOSED are forbidden positive claims: a real post-launch retro can only be published and filed after a completed launch and LCH-03 hypercare closure, which are owner/external operations outside this repository.

sessionDate.description: No retro session has run; no session date exists. Any non-null value is a forbidden claim.

facilitator.description: No facilitator is named. Any non-null name is a forbidden claim.

participants.description: No participant is named. The array is structurally forced empty.

findings.description: No retro finding is recorded. The array is structurally forced empty.

published.description: The retro is not published. true is a forbidden positive claim.

completed.description: The retro session is not completed. true is a forbidden positive claim.

filed.description: No retro record is filed. true is a forbidden positive claim.

closed.description: The retro is not closed. true is a forbidden positive claim.

actionItemsFiled.description: No action item is filed. true is a forbidden positive claim: filing real action items requires the owner team to hold and close the retro after launch and LCH-03 closure.

count.description: Zero action items. Any non-zero count is a forbidden claim.

items.description: No action item exists. The array is structurally forced empty so no real action item can be claimed.

status.description: Action-item status. COMPLETE, DONE, IN_PROGRESS, and CLOSED are forbidden positive claims; and because actionItems.items is maxItems 0, no action item may exist at all in repository-only foundations.

owner.description: No action-item owner is named. Any non-null name is a forbidden claim.

dueDate.description: No action-item due date exists. Any non-null value is a forbidden claim.

evidenceRef.description: No evidence reference authorizes an action item. Any non-null value is a forbidden claim.
